draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.42, the 21st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 3rd of 36 at CB. He went 32nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Amani Oruwariye. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 passes defended in 2022, 13th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 47 career games and 41 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 57.2 (97th percentile), completion % allowed 48.5% (95th percentile), passes defended 14 (93rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 76.8% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
